title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation
prompt: Model tenant-owned rows and write a row-level security policy. Test with two synthetic tenants and the actual restricted application role.
target_skills: SQL correctness, verification and safe change management

starter.content:
ALTER TABLE tenant_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid);

expected_output: A reviewable working artifact for Multi-Tenant Data Isolation with stated assumptions, expected results and verification evidence. Any live database operation remains a learner-run lab; no production execution is performed by CodeLeaf.
acceptance_criteria: Address the main task: Model tenant-owned rows and write a row-level security policy. Test with two synthetic tenants and the actual restricted application role.
Use only synthetic data in a disposable local database or provide a human-reviewed design artifact.
Show the expected result and at least one failure/edge-case check.
Explain any role/permission, transaction, migration, backup or cleanup implications relevant to this task.
hints: Start from the lesson and official references. Identify the minimal schema and version assumptions before coding.
Test with a tiny synthetic dataset; include both a normal result and at least one edge case.
For operations/security/recovery tasks, capture the exact evidence and confirm cleanup or isolation.
grading_method: Server-side case-sensitive substring smoke-check for documented required strings plus human review of SQL semantics, constraints, execution evidence and safety. The grader does not connect to PostgreSQL or execute arbitrary learner SQL.
retry_policy: Retries permitted after feedback; correct completion is recorded once by CodeLeaf. The platform controls XP; this file contains no XP override.
status_note: Derived from the attached PostgreSQL.pdf Section C exercise brief. Runtime correctness still requires a safe local PostgreSQL test and review.
